## Automatic tests

Automatic tests can be triggered on https://ci-apps-dev.yunohost.org/ _after creating the PR_, by commenting "!testme", "!gogogadgetoci" or "By the power of systemd, I invoke The Great App CI to test this Pull Request!". (N.B. : for this to work you need to be a member of the Yunohost-Apps organization)
